Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum layer-2 blockchain announced by Robinhood in 2025. Robinhood Chain is built using Arbitrum technology. Robinhood Chain is designed to support tokenized stock trading.

Cake DeFi is a centralized crypto platform rather than a decentralized protocol. Cake DeFi offers crypto staking and lending services. Cake DeFi is headquartered in Singapore.

Nexus Mutual operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Nexus Mutual provides cover against smart contract failures. Nexus Mutual is governed by holders of its NXM token, who vote on claim assessments.
